ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring platform that tracks and verifies corporate carbon offset plantation claims using geospatial imagery.
ideas.title: EcoGrid Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy technical integration of satellite imaging APIs and computer vision, mirroring the winning approach of GeoNex-ATLAS which succeeded in a general innovation and sustainability context.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence compliance platform that maps cross-border supply chain transactions to detect illegal wildlife and timber trafficking.
ideas.title: BioRisk Graph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the graph intelligence and risk scoring architecture that won the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon, applying complex relationship mapping to global sustainability challenges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace that deploys milestone-based humanitarian aid funding using transparent escrow and multi-signature verification.
ideas.title: Global Aid Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the autonomous agent marketplace pattern combined with secure escrow mechanics proven in the Synthesis Hackathon win.

ideas.pitch: A localized multi-agent student support and tutoring platform combining LangGraph workflows and RAG to assist displaced and refugee students.
ideas.title: EduBridge Multi-Agent Mentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Reuses the exact multi-agent architecture and RAG implementation that secured 1st place at the GreenNovation Hackathon, ensuring high technical execution quality.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven multilingual intake and trust engine for international medical missions, matching patients with remote specialists and verifying treatment histories.
ideas.title: Global Health Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Scales the rapid prototyping speed and Gemini integration of the Global-Smile win, tailored specifically to international healthcare accessibility.
